name: PolyU Entry Scholarships for Non-Local Undergraduate Students
amount: Half tuition up to renewable full tuition + allowance (up to HK$60,000–70,000/yr on 2026/27 terms); PolyU quotes up to HK$270,000/yr in total
dlText: Main round 11 Feb 2027 for most international-qualification programmes (some programmes closed 17 Nov 2026; late round to 14 May 2027); time not stated
note: Non-local applicants with international qualifications are considered automatically for academic entry scholarships; a separate STARS talent scholarship (half to full tuition + allowance) is chosen on the application form. Mainland Gaokao applicants follow a separate scheme.

name: CityUHK Entrance Scholarship for International Students
amount: Half tuition, full tuition, or Top Scholarship (full tuition + living allowance up to HK$60,000/yr), renewable
dlText: Regular application deadline 15 Jan 2027, time not stated (early round closed 15 Nov 2026; some programmes accept later applications on a rolling basis)

eligibility.note: Non-local (international) applicants to CityUHK bachelor's programmes; applicants from mainland China apply under a separate scheme, so check which one applies to you

note: Admitted international students with excellent results are selected automatically after admission. Mainland students have a separate scholarship scheme.

name: HKBU Admission Scholarships for Non-local Undergraduate Students
amount: Full Scholarship (100% tuition + subsidies), 100% Tuition Scholarship, Half Scholarship or ≥25% tuition awards; non-local tuition HK$240,000/yr (2027/28)
dlText: Main round 1 Feb 2027, 23:59 HKT (early round closed 16 Nov 2026; extended round to 31 May 2027)
note: Non-local applicants are considered automatically at admission; only the top tiers reach full or 100% tuition. Mainland students applying via the Gaokao (JEE) have a separate scheme.

name: Lingnan University Entrance Scholarships for Non-local Students
amount: Full Scholarship (tuition + hostel + partial living expenses), Full-tuition or Half-tuition Scholarship, renewable; non-local tuition HK$205,000/yr (2027-28, varies by programme)
dlText: Main round 28 Feb 2027, time not stated (early round closed 30 Nov 2026; final round for non-local applicants 30 Jun 2027)
fields: Lingnan UGC-funded undergraduate programmes (liberal arts, business, social sciences, data science)
note: Non-local first-year applicants to UGC-funded programmes are considered automatically; self-financed programmes are not eligible.

name: NTHU International Student Scholarship (Undergraduate)
amount: Type A: tuition and miscellaneous fees + NT$5,000/month; Type B: tuition and miscellaneous fees
dlText: Fall 2027 undergraduate admission 12 Nov 2026 – 25 Jan 2027, 15:00 Taiwan time (International Bachelor Program at Tsing Hua College: 22 Apr 2027 noon)
fields: Most NTHU undergraduate programmes (not Medicine, Dentistry or Chinese Medicine)
note: The applicant and both parents must hold foreign nationality and never have held Taiwan nationality. Insurance, dormitory and other fees are not covered.

name: NTU Scholarship for International Degree Students (Undergraduate)
amount: Tuition subsidy up to NT$200,000/yr + NT$8,000/month stipend
dlText: Second round 1 Dec 2026 – 28 Jan 2027, 16:00 Taiwan time (first round closed 19 Nov 2026)
tags: Tick the box on the admission form
note: Undergraduate applicants opt in on the admission form with no extra documents; the award runs for the standard study period if renewal conditions are met. Quotas depend on funding each year.

name: uOttawa Differential Tuition Fee Exemption Scholarship
amount: Roughly C$13,500 per eligible term in most faculties (C$19,000 in Engineering and some Science programmes) per uOttawa terms; confirm current value
dlText: Apply for admission by 15 Jan 2027 (recommended; most programmes close in May for international applicants); scholarship is automatic
tags: Programme in French or French Immersion
fields: Any uOttawa bachelor's programme taken in French or the French Immersion stream
note: For international students paying international fees who enrol full time in a French programme or French Immersion; renewable for up to 12 installments. Co-op work terms are not covered.

name: Claremont McKenna College need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted international students
dlText: Regular Decision 10 Jan 2027, time not stated (merit scholarship consideration by 1 Dec)
note: International applicants file CMC's own Financial Aid Application for International Students via the applicant portal; those who don't apply at admission can't get need-based aid later.

name: Lafayette College need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted international students
dlText: Regular Decision and CSS Profile 15 Jan 2027, 11:59 pm your local time (ED I closed 15 Nov)
note: Lafayette meets full demonstrated need of admitted students, including internationals, if all filing deadlines are met; an alternative form exists if the CSS Profile fee is a hardship.

name: Barnard College need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted international students
dlText: Regular Decision application 1 Jan 2027; CSS Profile and aid documents 15 Jan 2027
note: Barnard meets 100% of demonstrated need for all admitted students but has limited funding for international first-years; no institutional aid for international transfers.

name: Harvey Mudd College need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need, but only for a handful of admitted international students (about 3–4 a year; need-aware admission)
dlText: Regular Decision application 5 Jan 2027, time not stated; CSS Profile 1 Feb, finance documents 15 Feb 2027
tags: Apply in first year or never
note: HMC meets 100% of each admitted student's demonstrated need but funds only a small number of international students; the So Scholarship is a merit award for internationals.

name: Mount Holyoke College need-based aid (international)
amount: Meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted international students
dlText: Regular Decision application and CSS Profile 15 Jan 2027, time not stated
note: Mount Holyoke meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted students including internationals; packages mix grants, loans and campus work. Not declaring aid intent at application rules out aid for all four years.

name: École Polytechnique Bachelor of Science Scholarship for Olympiad Medalists
amount: Tuition + living allowance, capped at €87,900 (non-EU/EEA) or €78,750 (EU/EEA) over the programme; €1,500/yr admin fee remains
dlText: Round 3 closes 8 Feb 2027 (Round 2: 6 Jan 2027; Round 1 closed 20 Oct 2026); time assumed 23:59 Paris

eligibility.note: Admitted Bachelor of Science students of any nationality with a medal from an international subject Olympiad in the two years before enrolment

fields: Mathematics, physics, computer science, economics, chemistry, biology (BSc double majors)
note: Awarded only after admission and financial-aid committee decisions. Other Bachelor students can get need-based tuition waivers or a merit Excellence Scholarship (€4,800/yr), which are smaller.
